# Short-term price data

Public Yahoo Finance bars pulled with yfinance 0.2.65 on 2026-11-20 (`auto_adjust=False`, so OHLC are raw and `Adj Close` is split/dividend adjusted).

- `daily/yahoo_<T>.csv`: `period="max"`, 1d bars. Columns `Date,Open,High,Low,Close,Adj Close,Volume`.
- `h60/<T>.csv`: `period="730d"`, `interval="60m"`, `prepost=False`. Bars are labelled by their start (09:30, 10:30, ... 15:30).
- `m5/<T>.csv`: `period="60d"`, `interval="5m"`, `prepost=False`.

Intraday `Datetime` values are exactly as yfinance returns them: exchange local time, America/New_York, with the UTC offset included (`-05:00` EST / `-04:00` EDT). Daily dates are plain exchange dates.

Failures: none (all 168 ticker/interval pulls succeeded; up to 3 retries were allowed).
